svg.title: Promotion lifecycle
svg.desc: Starts when the page calls next.exitIntent({ image | template }). The popup waits: on a desktop until the mouse leaves through the top of the window; on a touch screen, with mobileScrollTrigger (or disableOnMobile false), until the shopper scrolls past 30% of a screen and back up more than 100px. It opens (promotion.viewed). A click on its image or a data-exit-intent-action button sends promotion.clicked, runs its action, and closes it (promotion.closed, reason clicked); apply-coupon does not wait for its code. Esc, the overlay or the page closing it sends promotion.closed with reason dismissed; the × of showCloseButton with reason close_button. It waits again while it has opened fewer than maxTriggers times this tab session (default 1).

g.text: mouse out the top, or scroll back up

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: Starts when the page calls next.exitIntent({ image | template }) · opens up to maxTriggers times a tab session (1)
reason: clicked (after promotion.clicked), dismissed (Esc, overlay, the page), close_button (×)
promotion.clicked comes before the action; apply-coupon’s coupon events can follow promotion.closed
